title: acer tschonoskii subsp. komarovii
intro: Acer tschonoskii subsp. komarovii, commonly known as Korean maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Korean maple are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Korean maple include reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and providing antioxidant protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
